notes: Tuition: the DAAD page states a 500 EUR per semester tuition fee for applicants from non-EU countries for this programme; the programme's own page says "No tuition fees, only student union fee" (https://www.th-deg.de/eti-b-en), so the two sources conflict. The university's fee page states a 500 EUR DIT service fee per semester for students from non-EU/EEA countries, which may be the same charge. Application channel: the programme is taught in English and the DAAD page says "Submit application via Please check this website"; other DIT pages state that applications are made directly via the university's own portal Primuss, not via uni-assist. Intake: the summer semester application period for this programme is given as 15 October - 1 December on the DAAD page and the university overview, without a year; no dated non-EU deadline is stated, so no intake was output. Language requirements: German A1 must be submitted by March 14 at the latest according to the programme page (https://www.th-deg.de/eti-b-en). Documents: the list comes from DIT's international-applicant application steps, not from a programme-specific list; the DIT page (English) also mentions "Certificate of exmatriculation, if you have already studied", omitted here because the page is cut off. Translation requirements are not stated in the quotes found.
